card.text: Orange dwarf 75 parsecs away, the larger of the two stars Kepler-16 (AB) b circles.

introduction.text: Kepler-16 A is an orange dwarf 65% as wide as the Sun. Every 41 days its small partner star B passes in front of it, and a Saturn-mass planet circles them both.
